coordinates.locator: centroid of OpenStreetMap building 1002 (RHIC interaction point 2, the 2 o'clock position); clock position from arXiv:nucl-ex/0503018 Section 2.1
coordinates.note: Campus-grade point, shown as approximate. BRAHMS's interaction region is the 2 o'clock position of the RHIC ring (thesis quote). The building is identified as 1002 by the RHIC numbering pattern (BNL's central campus map labels IP6 and IP8 as buildings 1006 and 1008) and by its position: the clock position derived from the OSM RHIC-ring geometry and the STAR/PHENIX halls falls within about 30 m of this building. No fetched source names the building that housed BRAHMS, hence confidence uncertain.
coordinates.quote: the four current experiments are at 6 o’clock (STAR), 8 o’clock (PHENIX), 10 o’clock (PHOBOS) and 2 o’clock (BRAHMS)

name: RHIC Interaction Point 2 (BRAHMS experimental hall)
notes: Interaction-point assignment from arXiv:nucl-ex/0503018; building identity inferred (see coordinate note).

summary.plain: The experimental hall at RHIC interaction point 2, at the 2 o'clock position of the collider ring at Brookhaven National Laboratory, where BRAHMS recorded heavy-ion collisions.
summary.technical: RHIC interaction region 2 (2 o'clock) experimental area, Brookhaven National Laboratory; the point is the centroid of the OpenStreetMap building 1002 (about 100 m precision), identified by the RHIC building-numbering pattern, not a surveyed detector position.
